headline: Autoliv Misses Q3 Profit Estimates and Trims Full-Year Operating Margin Target
summary: Automotive safety supplier Autoliv reported third-quarter earnings that fell short of analyst forecasts and narrowed its full-year operating margin guidance to approximately 10.5% amid persistent cost pressures.
why: Autoliv is the global market leader in airbags and seatbelts, providing critical insights into global light vehicle production volumes and automotive component supplier margins.

impacts.name: Autoliv Inc
impacts.why: Earnings misses and a lowered margin outlook indicate rising manufacturing costs and softer OEM auto volume demand.
